nom: Oak Essentials Cleansing Balm for Face

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are consistently positive, several saying it's the first cleanser that hydrates rather than strips their skin, with results described as soft, moisturized skin even in winter or dry climates.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation, burning, or stripping — several call it the only makeup remover their skin can tolerate.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report it cleans well without leaving them oily, though one who has combination skin herself thinks the balm may suit drier skin types even better than hers.
segments.mature: Two reviewers describe it as well suited to mature or perimenopausal skin, reporting softer, more nourished skin with regular use.

concerns.dehydration: By far the most repeated effect: reviewers across skin types say the balm cleanses without stripping or drying the skin, often leaving it noticeably softer and more hydrated afterward; some specifically contrast it with other cleansers that left them feeling dry or tight.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers, including some who rated the balm poorly, describe a lingering oily or greasy film that doesn't rinse away with water alone and needs a washcloth or second cleanser to fully remove; others, including a combination-skin reviewer, report it does not leave their skin feeling oily at all once properly removed.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer initially felt the balm caused breakouts and stopped using it, but found no such issue when she tried it again later; another credits it with helping her adult acne alongside other concerns.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer who reacts to many cleansers with burning and dryness says this balm does neither and actively soothes her skin instead.

aspects.libelle: Doesn't rinse off with plain water
Considered pricey for the amount you get
Concentrated, a little goes a long way
Can feel slightly slimy right after rinsing

extraits.texte: I'm reading all the positive good reviews, and had to double check that I did in fact have the same product. I hated this product because it felt like I was rubbing crisco/ thick grease all over my face. It wouldn't just come off with water either I had to scrape it off my face. The scent is very mild, but does have a light oak scent. I didn't like anything about this product, but maybe I just had a bad batch since there are so many great reviews.

The only positive thing I can say is there is a pleasant scent. I have used many balms and oils and this was an absolute nightmare to remove from my skin. Despite using a substantial cotton pad and cleaning my face TWICE with another cleanser, I still had an oily film on my face. This balm is a very thick grease layer that does not wash off easily. I'm so glad I trialed in the winter instead of humid summer because it would likely have been on my face for 1 week. WILL NEVER repurchase of recommend. Will stick to Farmacy balm and Tatcha oil cleanser.

This product grew on me. I received a free bottle as one of my platinum perks and had never heard of this particular brand. I use oils and cleansing balms regularly and have late 30s combo skin. It reminds me of the Eve Lom brand cleanser. I didnt reallt care for it the first few times I used it , but it really grew on me. I would recommend this to people with drier skin and I used it in the winter. Like some of the other reviews state, its super thick and does not emulsify like most of the other balms on the market. However I would apply to my face and gently massage into my skin and then add a small amount of warm water and repeat. Next I used a very warm and wet washcloth and laid it on my face and would press that into my skin. I then gently used that cloth to wipe off the balm and would repeat this a couple of times. This left my skin feeling so soft and refreshed. It was also nice to just slow down and really let the heat and steam sit on my face. Overall this wont be for everyone, but after I get used to the consistency I enjoyed using it. I also loved how it was basically scent free and gentle. The only other con is the price is expensive for the amount you get. I would estimate one jar may last a month with nightly use.

I absolutely could never live without this OK essentials cleansing balm. My skin has never looked better or felt more soft as I approach my menopausal era. My skin is in dire need of help and this is the perfect cleanser that I've ever found. I will never not have this in my, skincare routine

You do have to follow the directions with this one. Just wet a washcloth with warm water, and your makeup will simply melt off your skin. My face feels so soft afterwards. Highly recommend for dry skin.

extraits.texte: This balm is the ONLY makeup remover my skin can tolerate! Have tried so many cleasers and they burn and dry my skin. This does neither— it actually soothes it. Highlt recommended.

I tried this awhile back and felt it broke me out but I decided to do a skincare fast and try again and this is where is became a refreshing newness that I don't want to be without. So happy I tried it again…
